name: Ōchi (Saga, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Ōchi town emblem in white: an outlined ring of segments enclosing a ring.
history: Flag of the former town of Ōchi in Saga Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-01-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 16 September 1955.

features.role: Ōchi town emblem — an outlined ring of segments enclosing a ring
